policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the SBLGNT reading.

decisions.evidence: ASV 1:1 reads "an apostle of Christ Jesus"; the English word order renders Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, not the transposed Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ of r01.

ASV 1:5 renders the participle with completed aspect, "having been reminded of the unfeigned faith", which answers the aorist λαβών; the present λαμβάνων of r01 yields the iterative "when I call to remembrance" that ASV declined to keep.
ASV 1:10 reads "our Saviour Christ Jesus"; the order Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ is r01, against the base Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.
ASV 1:11 ends "and a teacher." with nothing rendering ἐθνῶν and no italicized supply, so the shorter διδάσκαλος stands; r01's "a teacher of the Gentiles" would be visible in the English.
ASV 1:17 reads "he sought me diligently", a positive adverb answering σπουδαίως; the comparative σπουδαιότερον of r01 would give "the more diligently".
